content: If development error detection is enabled and Dem_- SetEventStatus or Dem_ResetEventDebounceStatus is called before Dem_- Init or after Dem_Shutdown for events which have DemDebounceCounterStor- age set to True, the Dem module shall set the error code DEM_E_WRONG_CONDITION .
